text:
I received a massage to open my breast ducts. The massage was unprofessional and unsuccessful. The service was not up to par with the price. I went with a lump on my left breast. The symptoms lasted for one night and one day. Because I had experienced this before, I immediately called to make an appointment and didn't delay. However, the clinic required me to get tested for COVID before entering.
I didn't see a doctor and waited until the third floor.
The staff who came to treat me said they were Thai traditional medicine practitioners. Upon arrival, they examined my breasts and found it was an abscess. I told them it wasn't a blocked duct, but rather a blocked duct, as I had experienced it before. I had both Thai traditional massage and physical therapy in other provinces. They asked me to change my clothes and lie down without massaging. They only pressed the lump to release milk. They placed a herbal compress on the affected area and pressed the milk out. It was hot and painful from the tip of my fingernail. There was no massage at all. They only squeezed for an hour. The only problem was the breast. The cost was 2,500 baht. The lump didn't go away, and the pain worsened.
I don't recommend this service for breast duct opening.
